stories.title: US envoys meet Putin in Moscow for Ukraine talks
stories.body: Footage shows Vladimir Putin greeting Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, before saying the current situation "is not so easy".

stories.title: US hits three Iranian oil tankers after saying its warships were targeted
stories.body: Iran's state media reported that Tehran has launched retaliatory attacks against three US-affiliated vessels; the US is yet to comment.

stories.title: Mistrial declared in Lindsay Clancy murder case, after jury deadlocks
stories.body: The mistrial now puts the murder case - and Clancy's future - in limbo as to whether she will be held criminally liable in the deaths of her three kids.

stories.title: At least two dead in blast at Bolivia military barracks
stories.body: Authorities fear the death toll in Viacha will rise and warn people to stay away from the barracks due to a risk of further explosions.

stories.title: Prince William to attend King Harald's funeral in Norway
stories.body: The Prince of Wales will represent the King at the funeral of Harald V in Oslo next week.

stories.title: TV presenter among 11 sentenced to death in Egypt drugs case
stories.body: Sarah Khalifa is best known for her TV programme Mission Impossible which dealt with crime issues.

stories.title: What different world maps get right - and what they get wrong
stories.body: As the UN adopts a new world map to reflect Africa's true size, let's take a closer look at what different maps get right and wrong.

stories.title: Trump signs order to remove endangered species protection for grey wolves
stories.body: The US president says the move will help ranchers, but conservationists say it could derail efforts to recover populations.

stories.title: Europe targeted by spiralling campaign of sabotage - and Russia is the chief suspect
stories.body: Germany has blamed Russia for an attack on Leipzig airport but there has been a series of suspicious incidents elsewhere.

stories.title: Nepal rescuers try to reach dozens trapped in tunnel after two found alive
stories.body: More than 1,300 people have died and thousands are missing, but rescuers' hopes have risen after finding survivors in a tunnel.

stories.title: Germany's far-right AfD bids for first taste of power in eastern vote
stories.body: If it wins an outright majority in Saxony-Anhalt, it would be the first time a far-right party has held state-level power in Germany since World War Two.

stories.title: UN votes to adopt new world map to reflect Africa's true size
stories.body: The Togo-sponsored resolution was backed by 164 nations - with the US as the only nation to vote against it.

stories.title: Russia hits Ukrainian security headquarters in drone attack, Zelensky says
stories.body: The unmanned aerial vehicle struck without warning in the heart of the Ukrainian capital.

stories.title: 'A rare moment of joy': Nepal tunnel rescues bring hope for more flood survivors
stories.body: There are still hundreds of workers trapped in a network of tunnels that run along the Trishuli river.

stories.title: Tate brothers officially indicted with trafficking and sex crimes in Romania
stories.body: Andrew and Tristan Tate are currently in a Miami jail fighting extradition to the UK over separate charges and deny all the allegations.

stories.title: Argentine couple to return Nazi-looted painting to rightful owner
stories.body: The late-baroque Portrait of a Lady was lost for 80 years until it was spotted in photographs of a house for sale near Buenos Aires.

stories.title: UK support for Falkland Islands 'unwavering' after Argentina restates claims, No 10 says
stories.body: The comments come as Argentinian president Javier Milei says the "winds of change" favoured his country's claim on the British overseas territory.

stories.title: Body of world's youngest traditional king returns home to Uganda amid succession row
stories.body: King Oyo died in the US last week aged 34 after receiving treatment for an aggressive form of cancer.

stories.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial has divided US on whether she's victim or criminal
stories.body: Some say the case shed light on the mental health struggles of mothers, while others argue it's no excuse for murder.

stories.title: Why are European countries moving their gold out of North America?
stories.body: The Netherlands has relocated 86 tonnes of the shiny stuff - what's going on?
